description: Metrics emitted by the scheduled backup/recovery drill runner rather than a Go process. The schedule runner atomically writes this textfile for the node_exporter textfile collector; check_monitoring.py cross-checks every name against schedule.py METRIC_SPECS so the manifest cannot drift from the emitter.

metrics.name: evia_backup_up
metrics.help: 1 if the last drill for this target verified a restore, otherwise 0

metrics.name: evia_backup_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: Unix timestamp of the last scheduled drill attempt

metrics.name: evia_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: Unix timestamp of the last successful drill, 0 if never

metrics.name: evia_backup_success_total
metrics.help: Cumulative successful drill runs since the state file was created

metrics.name: evia_backup_failure_total
metrics.help: Cumulative failed drill runs since the state file was created

metrics.name: evia_backup_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Wall-clock duration of the last drill attempt
